cars.generation: BG Familia / 323 GT-R production-road homologation hatchback family

cars.specification_market: Original Mazda/JAF A-5473 base form, effective 1 January 1993, JAF recognition dated 31 October 1992. Download contains 82 pages: base application PDF13–32 reviewed in context; identity/engine/transmission/suspension/brake PDF13,16,24–25,27–28 individually enlarged. cars.generation: Original 405 T16 four-wheel-drive production-road sports-saloon family
cars.specification_market: Original French 1993 T16 manufacturer brochure, eight hosted scans rendered and reviewed; technical PDF6 and engine/drivetrain PDF7–8 individually enlarged. The scan order includes split/cropped spreads. DIN ch/mkg are retained as printed; separately labelled CEE kW/torque figures are not silently converted into DIN values. Overboost output is not described as continuous power. Retrospective translated bhp and 7-second acceleration are not mixed with the original table. Dakar/Pikes Peak silhouette cars are excluded.
cars.summary: The 405 T16 combined a turbocharged sixteen-valve engine, permanent four-wheel drive, a viscous centre coupling and Torsen rear differential in a discreet road saloon. Its variable-geometry turbo and controlled rear suspension make it a distinctive performance-engineering flagship.
cars.admission_reason: The 405 T16 combined a turbocharged sixteen-valve engine, permanent four-wheel drive, a viscous centre coupling and Torsen rear differential in a discreet road saloon. cars.generation: Original Xantia Activa SC/CAR production-road chassis family
cars.variant: V6 Activa — 1999 French manufacturer technical reference
cars.specification_market: Original Automobiles Citroën Carnet de poche 99, hosted manufacturer aftersales technical handbook. Relevant PDF5/printed3 V6 Activa identity column, PDF30/printed95 injection, PDF50/printed174 steering, PDF52/printed187 saloon brakes and PDF64/printed216 V6 BVM SC/CAR application individually rendered/read. 89-page handbook is not a sales brochure; adjacent automatic Exclusive, ordinary Hydractive and estate columns are excluded. Power, tyre size and performance figures absent from these selected pages are omitted.
cars.summary: The Xantia Activa is a landmark in road-car chassis engineering: SC/CAR hydraulic active roll control supplements Hydractive suspension to keep the body level through corners. The selected V6 manual represents this exceptional production-road system, rather than the ordinary Xantia range.
